fields.label: Structure Fixes
fields.help: Remove content before the first H1, drop configured headings, prune sections below the minimum-size threshold, and fix empty or missing top-level headings.

fields.label: Heading Normalization
fields.help: Strip numbering from headings (e.g. '3.2 Example' -> 'Example') and ensure blank lines around markdown and bold headings.

fields.label: Link Fixes
fields.help: Fix 'See also' blocks, normalize URL formatting, and remove duplicated standalone URL lines.

fields.label: Code Fence Fixes
fields.help: Add language IDs to bare code fences, remove prose duplicated immediately before a fence, and strip line numbers inside fences.

fields.label: Table Repair
fields.help: Remove wrapped table rows and repair broken markdown table rows.

fields.label: List Normalization
fields.help: Normalize unordered/ordered list spacing and caution admonitions.

fields.label: Custom Regex Cleanup
fields.help: Apply the CSV-driven regex replacements (common/regex_replacements.csv) as the final cleanup pass.
